environment: Ubuntu WSL, Go 1.26.0, PostgreSQL 16.14, isolated migration-backed schemas

checks.name: search_postgres_behavior
checks.detail: Russian and English body search, quoted phrase, display name only when present in body, global DM participant ACL, third-party administrator exclusion, and cursor pagination across equal timestamps passed.

checks.name: search_indexes
checks.detail: EXPLAIN with sequential scans disabled chose both partial GIN search indexes for TEXT and DM tables.

checks.name: migrations_empty_and_existing
checks.detail: Embedded migrations passed on an empty schema and on a schema seeded through migration 0025 with legacy TEXT and DM rows; a repeated full Run passed and search vectors indexed the legacy rows.

checks.name: backend_suite
checks.detail: go test -json -count=1 ./... with both PostgreSQL URLs: 654 passed, 0 skipped, 0 failed; focused go vet passed.

checks.name: release_guard_linux
checks.detail: Contracts, 39 approved requirement IDs, Compose interpolation, image guard, and both deploy shell suites passed in Ubuntu WSL. PowerShell 7.6.6 and Compose 5.5.0 downloads were checked against official release SHA-256 values.

checks.name: trusted_gitverse_pipeline
checks.detail: The changed master-only GitVerse workflow has not run remotely; cloud package/network availability and the deploy dependency gate remain unverified.

limitations: Forced-index EXPLAIN proves index availability, not production selectivity or latency under load.
Local WSL checks do not close the trusted GitVerse release gate.
